prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss from the insured driver. Vehicle sustained front-end damage in an intersection collision while the insured was turning left. Other vehicle reportedly failed to yield on the opposing through lane. Scene photos requested and police report number pending.

Entry 2: Claimant's vehicle inspected at repair facility. Damage consistent with the reported impact pattern, including bumper, hood, and right headlamp assembly. Estimate obtained and under review. Liability position still being evaluated pending statements from both drivers and any available traffic signal data.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation placed in file. Requested medical authorization and records through counsel, and noted claimant's report of lower back strain following the collision.

Entry 4: Received preliminary medical documentation from claimant's treating provider. Diagnosis listed as lumbar strain with recommended physical therapy. No surgical intervention indicated at this time. Bodily injury reserve reviewed and adjusted. Will reassess once treatment progress reports arrive.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding status. Attorney requested a demand package once treatment concludes. Confirmed liability investigation ongoing and third-party carrier notified of the claim. Diary set for follow-up on treatment records and the physical therapy schedule.
